title: Build TodoItem component with toggle, delete, and inline editing
active_form: Building TodoItem component with toggle, delete, and inline editing
description:
Create the TodoItem component that displays a single todo with full interaction support. The component receives a Todo object and callback props (onToggle, onDelete, onEdit). It renders a checkbox (shadcn/ui Checkbox) for toggling completion, the todo text, and a delete button. Completed todos display with strikethrough text and muted styling and are not editable. Double-clicking the text of an incomplete todo enters edit mode with the current text in an input field. In edit mode: pressing Enter saves the edited text via onEdit, pressing Escape cancels and reverts, clicking outside (blur) cancels the edit, and submitting empty text calls onDelete to remove the todo.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Sections 5.2, 5.3, 5.4

functional: Checkbox toggles completion status via onToggle callback
Completed todos display with strikethrough text and muted styling
Delete button is visible and removes the todo via onDelete callback
Double-clicking todo text enters edit mode with current text in an input
Pressing Enter in edit mode saves the edited text via onEdit
Pressing Escape in edit mode cancels and reverts to original text
Clicking outside (blur) in edit mode cancels the edit
edge_cases: Submitting empty text in edit mode deletes the todo
Double-clicking a completed todo does not enter edit mode

testing_requirements.target: Enter saves edit, Escape cancels edit, blur cancels edit
Completed todos show strikethrough and block edit mode
